component.name: Role 文件恢复示例
component.description: 仅创建隔离示例文件并恢复原始内容，用于演示显式检查及备份。

release.releaseNotes: 新 Role 合同示例；导入后为 Draft，需完成环境验证。

playbooks.content:
- name: Inspect current file independently
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ cf.inputs.target_path }}"
  register: cf_local_current
- name: Create recovery directory
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_ref }}"
    state: directory
    mode: '0700'
- name: Detect existing baseline
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_marker }}"
  register: cf_local_baseline
- name: Read retained recovery identity
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_marker }}"
  register: cf_local_identity
  when: cf_local_baseline.stat.exists
- name: Reject a replaced recovery baseline
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: (cf_local_identity.content | b64decode | from_json).metadata == cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_metadata
  when: cf_local_baseline.stat.exists
- name: Capture original file only once
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    src: "{{ cf.inputs.target_path }}"
    dest: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_ref }}/original"
    remote_src: true
    mode: preserve
  when: not cf_local_baseline.stat.exists and cf_local_current.stat.exists
- name: Persist original existence only once
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ {'existed': cf_local_current.stat.exists, 'metadata': cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_metadata} | to_json }}"
    dest: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_marker }}"
    mode: '0600'
    force: false
- name: Install example file
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ cf.inputs.content }}"
    dest: "{{ cf.inputs.target_path }}"
    mode: '0600'

- name: Read original baseline
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_marker }}"
  register: cf_local_baseline
- name: Restore original file
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    src: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_ref }}/original"
    dest: "{{ cf.inputs.target_path }}"
    remote_src: true
    mode: preserve
  when: (cf_local_baseline.content | b64decode | from_json).existed
- name: Restore original absence
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ cf.inputs.target_path }}"
    state: absent
  when: not (cf_local_baseline.content | b64decode | from_json).existed

- name: Validate example target
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - cf.inputs.target_path is match('^/tmp/clusterforge-example-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$')
      - cf.inputs.content is string

- name: Read installed example
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: "{{ cf.inputs.target_path }}"
  register: cf_local_installed
- name: Confirm installed content
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: (cf_local_installed.content | b64decode) == cf.inputs.content

- name: Read recovery baseline independently
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_marker }}"
  register: cf_local_baseline
- name: Confirm baseline is usable
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - (cf_local_baseline.content | b64decode | from_json).existed is boolean
      - (cf_local_baseline.content | b64decode | from_json).metadata == cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_metadata

- name: Read original existence
  ansible.builtin.slurp:
    src: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_marker }}"
  register: cf_local_baseline
- name: Inspect restored target
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ cf.inputs.target_path }}"
    checksum_algorithm: sha256
  register: cf_local_restored
- name: Inspect preserved original
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ cf.inputs.clusterforge_backup_ref }}/original"
    checksum_algorithm: sha256
  register: cf_local_original
- name: Confirm original state is restored
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - cf_local_restored.stat.exists == (cf_local_baseline.content | b64decode | from_json).existed
      - not cf_local_restored.stat.exists or cf_local_restored.stat.checksum == cf_local_original.stat.checksum
